scene: Tapping the can summons a travel robot with three departure gates.
picture: Flat side view. Along one level platform, an open gate on the far left reveals a subway train. The player stands left in her yellow raincoat and green boots, holding her red umbrella. Centre sits an open glass arch beside a waiting tram. Far right, an open wooden gate leads to a docked ferry.
shown: A steel subway train idling behind an open sliding gate on the far left.
A yellow street tram waiting beside an open glass archway in the centre.
A blue harbour ferry floating by an open wooden pier gate far right.
